jobs.title: Director Administration
jobs.description:
Qualification:
MBA/MS or an equivalent qualification in the discipline, with analytical abilities and demonstrated experience in management and administration, preferably in a reputed organization.
Core Competency:
A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in Administration, Human Resource Management, adequate experience in procurement, accounts and finance.
Experience in budget management, coordination and decision-making.
Core Values:
Leadership, teamwork, and mentorship, with a commitment to enhance organizational efficiency
Integrity, professionalism, transparency, and accountability in all institutional activities.
Adaptability and a result oriented approach to advancing the Institute’s objectives.
Age:
Age not more than 50 years
